title: RPF-8N: public nominal-count preimage columns and smaller exact bounded lists

claims.statement: ONE RPF-8N program: for EVERY N>=2, n=ceil(log2N), secret s and execution branch, unconditional full-secret success>=2/3 at structured fixed-joint malformed fraction1/32; TOTAL T=O(2^(199n/500)n^(5421/250)), growth index1. All source, caps, failed work, Clifford+T generation and full addresses count. Joint with all other claims.

Same ONE RPF-8N program, success, tolerance, every N-secret/branch: peak allocated classical space O(n^2), growth index0, including all immutable source/score records and streamed controller/generator. Joint with all other claims.

Same ONE RPF-8N program, success, tolerance, every N-secret/branch: ENTIRE peak quantum space O(2^(n/8)n^13), growth index1, including all padded/saved join histories, bounded mark/output/inverse work, sources, raw coins, arithmetic and zero-phase/reflection apparatus. Joint with all other claims.

Same ONE RPF-8N program, success, tolerance, every N-secret/branch: EXACT Q=3*2^40(n+32) original source acquisitions, O(n), growth index0, including abort/discard/unused/fallback and all reuse cycles. No source control/preparation inverse. Joint with all other claims.

Same ONE RPF-8N program and ALL FOUR joint resources: entire-secret unconditional success>=2/3 for every N>=2,s under EXACT structured fixed-joint-good-marginal fraction1/32, arbitrary allowed good/bad/reference correlations and fixed-set mixtures. Full-reference coupling, unconditional score/completeness events and binary reachable-range safety supplied.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
